title: ValidationRecord
description: The 'validate' phase of ENSIM's tasking sequence (ARCHITECTURE.md Section 3). Covers the three coordination/approval artifacts between the initial request and the ATO line in org-doctrine-model's hadr-request-and-tasking-flow doctrine process (steps 2-4): requirement validation, tasking-authority approval, and Joint Task Force stand-up. One schema, distinguished by recordType, rather than three near-identical schemas — these are all 'someone in the chain validated/approved something' shaped.

recordType.description: Maps to doctrine-processes.json hadr-request-and-tasking-flow step 2 ('Validated requirement'), step 3 ('Approved tasking authority'), and step 4 ('Joint Task Force stand-up order') respectively.
